title: Alice in Borderland - Music pack
description: This texture pack changes music discs to music from AIB series.
body:
There are lot of people just like me who likes to have custom music in minecraft.
And sometimes you just find a perfect music for minecraft and you dont know how to add it?.

I was once there.. And I learned it.

So... There is a pack with music from AIB.

---------------------------------------------------
